Cross-fit a policy learner

Source: R/generics.R
crossfit.Rd

Trains the policy learner in outer folds and stores out-of-fold predictions for benchmark rows. Cross-fitting estimates how the meta-policy learner behaves on anchors it did not train on, which is the calibration target used later by calibrate_uncertainty() for post-selection intervals.

Usage

crossfit(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A PolicyLearner object created from a benchmarked PolicySelector.

...

Cross-fitting controls such as benchmark table overrides, fold count, group column, learner method, feature columns, seed, workers, or progress display.

Value

The supplied PolicyLearner updated with cross-fit predictions, prepared training data, and resolved learner settings.

Details

The method prepares the benchmark-derived training frame, resolves feature columns and learner controls from the object configuration, fits one learner per fold, and stores fold predictions plus the resolved training settings on the returned PolicyLearner. It clears any final fit or calibration state because those depend on the cross-fit results.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
learner <- as_policylearner(selector)
learner <- crossfit(learner)
} # }
